comment: The Haro v0.9 conformance floor, written BEFORE the court that passes it (the W discipline: fixtures first, prose second). v0.9 grows v0.8 by what A -- the alphabet's A letter, the ALGORITHM: bounded iteration, structured steps, total (haro/SPIKE.md, the ninth rung) -- needs and nothing else: RUN, the kinetic declaration that says which kind of a language is run (OF: the kind, its steps list, its result names) and which kinds play the five structured constructs -- COMPUTE a value into a name, COLLECT a value into a list, GROUP values by a key, BRANCH on a condition into two step lists, ITERATE over a named collection with each item bound to a name through a step list -- each a kind and its seats by role; and a list seat whose element is a UNION of declarations (a step list names steps of several kinds). Nothing in a RUN can loop without a collection, and a step list that re-enters a step is refused: termination is structural. Every v0.8 fixture still passes: v0.9 refuses nothing v0.8 accepted. Rejects carry the fragment the refusal must contain.

accepts.name: a RUN: OF the run kind, and the five constructs each a kind and its seats by role
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE a AS (VERSION "0.9", GRAMMAR "0.9", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".a") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE EXPRESSION aexpr AS (OPERATORS [or, and, cmp, add, mul], OPERANDS [number, text, ref]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM word AS (SEATS [name: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION compute AS (VERB "COMPUTE", SEATS [into: name, value: aexpr]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION collect AS (VERB "COLLECT", SEATS [into: name, value: aexpr]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION group AS (VERB "GROUP", SEATS [into: name, by: aexpr, value: aexpr]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION branch AS (VERB "BRANCH", SEATS [when: aexpr, then: [step], else: [step]]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION iterate AS (VERB "ITERATE", SEATS [over: name, as: name, do: [step]]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE UNION step AS (OF [compute, collect, group, branch, iterate]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION algorithm AS (VERB "ALGORITHM", SEATS [steps: [step], result: [word]]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE RUN a AS (OF [algorithm, steps, result], COMPUTE [compute, into, value], COLLECT [collect, into, value], GROUP [group, into, by, value], BRANCH [branch, when, then, else], ITERATE [iterate, over, as, do]) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: a RUN with OF and COMPUTE alone: a language of straight-line computations
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE a AS (VERSION "0.9", GRAMMAR "0.9", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".a") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE EXPRESSION aexpr AS (OPERATORS [add], OPERANDS [number, ref]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM word AS (SEATS [name: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION compute AS (VERB "COMPUTE", SEATS [into: name, value: aexpr]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION algorithm AS (VERB "ALGORITHM", SEATS [steps: [compute], result: [word]]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE RUN a AS (OF [algorithm, steps, result], COMPUTE [compute, into, value]) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: a list seat whose element is a UNION of declarations: a step list names steps of several kinds
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE a AS (VERSION "0.9", GRAMMAR "0.9", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".a") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION compute AS (VERB "COMPUTE", SEATS [into: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION collect AS (VERB "COLLECT", SEATS [into: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE UNION step AS (OF [compute, collect]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION algorithm AS (VERB "ALGORITHM", SEATS [steps: [step]]) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: a v0.8 declaration is a v0.9 declaration: v0.8's A2, unchanged
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE f AS (VERSION "0.8", GRAMMAR "0.8", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".f") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU verbs AS (WORDS [notify, reassign]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION actor AS (VERB "ACTOR", SEATS [role: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION guard AS (VERB "GUARD", SEATS [norm: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION terminal AS (VERB "TERMINAL", SEATS [outcome: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION step AS (VERB "STEP", SEATS [target: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE UNION node AS (OF [step, terminal]) RATIONALE "a target is a step or a terminal, told apart by name"
DEFINE FORM action AS (SEATS [verb: verbs, target: actor]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM branch AS (SEATS [guard: guard, target: node]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION escalation AS (VERB "ESCALATION", SEATS [on_breach: [action]]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION routing AS (VERB "ROUTING", SEATS [when: [branch], otherwise: node]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: OF names a DECLARATION of this language and its seats
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE a AS (VERSION "0.9", GRAMMAR "0.9", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".a") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION compute AS (VERB "COMPUTE", SEATS [into: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE RUN a AS (OF [program, steps, result]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a construct's value seat is an EXPRESSION seat of its kind
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE a AS (VERSION "0.9", GRAMMAR "0.9", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".a") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM word AS (SEATS [name: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION compute AS (VERB "COMPUTE", SEATS [into: name, value: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION algorithm AS (VERB "ALGORITHM", SEATS [steps: [compute], result: [word]]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE RUN a AS (OF [algorithm, steps, result], COMPUTE [compute, into, value]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: COMPUTE: 'value' is not an expression seat of compute

rejects.name: each construct names a kind and exactly its roles' seats
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE a AS (VERSION "0.9", GRAMMAR "0.9", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".a") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE EXPRESSION aexpr AS (OPERATORS [cmp], OPERANDS [number, ref]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM word AS (SEATS [name: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION branch AS (VERB "BRANCH", SEATS [when: aexpr, then: [branch]]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION algorithm AS (VERB "ALGORITHM", SEATS [steps: [branch], result: [word]]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE RUN a AS (OF [algorithm, steps, result], BRANCH [branch, when, then]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: BRANCH names a kind and three seats: when, then, else

rejects.name: a .haro file declares at most one RUN
rejects.source:

DEFINE DECLARATION compute AS (VERB "COMPUTE", SEATS [into: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION algorithm AS (VERB "ALGORITHM", SEATS [steps: [compute], result: [word]]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE RUN a AS (OF [algorithm, steps, result]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE RUN b AS (OF [algorithm, steps, result]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a list seat's element UNION is a UNION of DECLARATIONs
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE a AS (VERSION "0.9", GRAMMAR "0.9", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".a") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU words AS (WORDS [one, two]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORMAT key AS (SHAPE hex64) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE UNION either AS (OF [words, key]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION thing AS (VERB "THING", SEATS [items: [either]]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: a list seat's element UNION is a UNION of DECLARATIONs

rejects.name: ITERATE's over and as seats are names, its do a list of steps
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE a AS (VERSION "0.9", GRAMMAR "0.9", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".a") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE EXPRESSION aexpr AS (OPERATORS [cmp], OPERANDS [number, ref]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM word AS (SEATS [name: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION iterate AS (VERB "ITERATE", SEATS [over: aexpr, as: name, do: [iterate]]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION algorithm AS (VERB "ALGORITHM", SEATS [steps: [iterate], result: [word]]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE RUN a AS (OF [algorithm, steps, result], ITERATE [iterate, over, as, do]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: ITERATE: 'over' is not a name seat of iterate
